nom: Pixi Botanical Collagen Tonic Volumizing Toner

avis.texte: When i put it on the back of my hand to see how it woukd dry down i was impressed. When i put it on my face i washed it off right away. Zero hydration, my skin felt tight. On the back of my hand it looked hydrating and even. Not for dry skin in the dead of winter.
Smells great, makes my skin glow and is so moisturizing. I love it. The smaller size is great for travel as well.

This feels very soft and fresh going on the skin. I usually really hate fragrance but this is light and pleasant. I am noticing that my face feels fuller now that I've started using more collagen products. It does seem to leave a little kind of sticky feeling, but once I start layering my other products it's fine. Maybe I need to use less.
I really like this toner. It goes on nicely, has a subtle, clean smell and really seems to refresh my skin. It's a nice add on to my every day routine
Love how this feels in my skin. Simple step added to my routine
Glow tonic at night and collagen by day. This product leaves my skin feeling very soft.
Absolutely love this tonic! My skin feels so good after using it!
Completely rehydrating and revitalizing! Within a few days of use I can already see a major difference!! My skin looks fuller and more lively! Thank you Pixi!
This leaves my skin so hydrated and also leaves it deeking plumped.
I really like this tonic. It smells good and it makes my skin feel plump I love the idea of a collagen focused toner.

Didn't know what to expect but this is a really gentle little tonic that makes my face look and feel fresh. Thats the best way I can describe it- refreshing. I love to use it after I cleanse after work to take the day off. I'll definitely repurchase the larger size.
